test_ascii_table_simple: test the ascii_table function with a list of row dictionaries and no headers
test_ascii_table_with_headers: test the ascii_table function with row data and a headers dictionary for column labels
test_ascii_table_with_footers: test the ascii_table function with row data, headers, and a footers dictionary
run_ascii_table_test_suite: run the unittest TestTables suite to verify ascii_table output for simple, header, and footer cases
review_ascii_table_test: review the TestTables class and its three test methods for ascii_table edge cases
